security_annotations.description: CRD LLMBatchGateway has user-settable image field "spec.processor.imagePullPolicy". The operator deploys containers using this value with its own ServiceAccount. A user-controlled image runs with the operator's permissions.

CRD LLMBatchGateway has user-settable image field "spec.processor.asyncConfig.imagePullPolicy". The operator deploys containers using this value with its own ServiceAccount. A user-controlled image runs with the operator's permissions.

CRD LLMBatchGateway has user-settable image field "spec.apiServer.imagePullPolicy". The operator deploys containers using this value with its own ServiceAccount. A user-controlled image runs with the operator's permissions.

CRD LLMBatchGateway has user-settable image field "spec.gc.imagePullPolicy". The operator deploys containers using this value with its own ServiceAccount. A user-controlled image runs with the operator's permissions.
Workflow "CI" has no top-level permissions block. Without explicit permissions, the GITHUB_TOKEN gets default permissions which may be overly broad (write access to contents, packages, etc.).
Role uses default kubebuilder name "leader-election-role". When multiple operators are deployed, these generic names collide. Prefix with the operator name.
RoleBinding uses default kubebuilder name "leader-election-rolebinding". Prefix with the operator name to avoid collisions.
